# TheYard, by Steven Stout

> TheYard is a used-vehicle auction platform that Steven Stout, a Lead / Staff .NET engineer, built and runs on Azure: 100,000 vehicles, live bidding, and the same build on Azure SQL Database and on Azure Cosmos DB, in .NET 10 and React. Every decision behind it is written down as a record and served from inside the app. Each document below is plain markdown, readable without running the app.

## About the author

- [Steven Stout](https://theyard.stevenstout.biz/about): who he is, the resume's title line, and what TheYard proves
